map.对比时要保证口径一致吗？: Must the comparison use a consistent basis?
map.必须。A、B 两个数值应是同一货物、同一线路、同一计费单位（如同为「单件到门价」: Yes. A and B should be costs for the same goods, same route, same billing unit (e.g., both "per-unit door price" or both "per cubic meter"), otherwise the ratio is meaningless.
